intro: Subway is the build-your-own sandwich giant, where you pick a 6-inch or footlong, choose your bread, protein and toppings, and watch it made to order. The Subway Series signature subs took the guesswork out, and No Bready Bowls, wraps and salads round it out. Below is the full Subway menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: A 6-inch Subway sub runs about $5.29 to $6.99 and a footlong about $7.99 to $10.49, depending on the filling. The Subway Series signature subs are roughly $12 to $15. The Meatball Marinara footlong is 1,040 calories, while a 6-inch Veggie Delite is just 230. Everything is built to order.
hot_deal: Subway value: the chain has leaned into footlong value meals and app-only deals, including $6.99 footlongs on select subs and footlong-plus-sides bundles. The 6-inch Veggie Delite ($5.29) and Black Forest Ham ($5.99) are the cheapest subs, and the Subway Series is the premium tier. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a footlong at Subway?
faqs.a: A footlong sub runs about $7.99 to $10.49 depending on the filling, with the Veggie Delite the cheapest and Meatball Marinara and Steak & Cheese at the top. The 6-inch versions are a few dollars less.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a 6-inch and a footlong?
faqs.a: A footlong is a full 12-inch sub, essentially two 6-inch subs, and has roughly double the calories. A 6-inch is the half size and the cheaper, lighter option.
The Subway Series is a lineup of numbered, pre-built signature subs like The Boss, The Philly and The Ultimate B.M.T., so you can order a popular combination by name instead of building your own.

faqs.q: What is the healthiest sub at Subway?
faqs.a: The 6-inch Veggie Delite (about 230 calories) and the Oven-Roasted Turkey (about 310) are the lightest. The No Bready Bowls, like the turkey bowl at 170 calories, drop even more by skipping the bread.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Subway?
faqs.a: The best known are the Italian B.M.T., Meatball Marinara, Steak & Cheese, Oven-Roasted Turkey, and the Veggie Delite, along with the warm chocolate chip cookies.
